paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse

model_annotation: The grouped bar chart illustrates the performance, identified in the caption as macro-averaged F1 scores, of three different models under three distinct prompting conditions. The horizontal category axis displays three models in the following order: Gemini, GPT4o, and Sonnet, without an explicit axis title. The vertical value axis features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.7, with numeric tick labels evenly spaced at intervals of 0.1, also lacking an explicit axis title or specific measurement units on the axis itself. Within each model category on the horizontal axis, the bars are visually arranged in side-by-side groups of three, corresponding to the prompt types defined in the legend located at the bottom of the image. The first bar in each group represents the "Basic prompt" condition and is colored dark blue; the second represents the "Structured prompt + oracle" condition and is colored orange; and the third represents the "Structured prompt + predicted" condition and is colored dark green. Across all three model categories, the orange "Structured prompt + oracle" bars are consistently the tallest, with the highest overall value appearing in the Gemini group at approximately 0.60, followed by GPT4o at roughly 0.58 and Sonnet at roughly 0.52. The dark blue "Basic prompt" bars generally represent the lowest values within each group, including the shortest bar on the chart located in the GPT4o group at approximately 0.26, while the basic prompts for Gemini and Sonnet reach approximately 0.32 and 0.34, respectively. The dark green "Structured prompt + predicted" bars reach approximate heights of 0.35 for Gemini, 0.47 for GPT4o, and 0.42 for Sonnet. The main categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically or by any strictly ascending or descending numerical value, and none of the individual bars are visually emphasized with additional shading, outlines, or annotations.
